description: 72 tools for the OpenProject API v3: work packages, attachments, git activity, time, reporting
name: io.github.kar-thik/openproject-mcp-server

environmentVariables.description: OpenProject instance root URL, e.g. https://openproject.example.com
environmentVariables.name: OPENPROJECT_URL

environmentVariables.description: API key from My account -> Access tokens in OpenProject
environmentVariables.name: OPENPROJECT_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to serve read tools only
environmentVariables.name: OPENPROJECT_MCP_READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable the membership-write tools (hidden by default)
environmentVariables.name: OPENPROJECT_MCP_ADMIN_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool groups to drop, e.g. meetings,budgets
environmentVariables.name: OPENPROJECT_MCP_DISABLE

title: OpenProject
